Fixed in apps/DeciderVisionGate/Sources/GateSupport.swift (an autorelease pool per chunk): on the Mac the assets+md5 stages end at 40.7 MB of footprint instead of 4,024.5 MB (mac_runs/md5-before-*, md5-after-*), md5 unchanged.
